hotels.nearestTransit: Subway Line 2 Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn (Exit 5 or 6, 2-min walk); Subway Line 4 Myeong-dong Stn (Exit 6, 6-min walk); Airport Bus 6015 (Lotte Hotel / Ibis Myeong-dong stop)
hotels.notes: Lobby is on the 9th floor (same building as Apple Myeongdong). Early check-in / late check-out fee: 20,000 KRW/hour (subject to availability). Free luggage lockers on 9F.

hotels.verifiedName: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE (L7 해운대 바이 롯데)
hotels.nearestTransit: Busan Metro Line 2 Haeundae Stn (Exit 5 or 3, 5–7 min walk); 3-min walk to Haeundae Beach & Haeundae Market
hotels.notes: Opened 2024; 3F Check-in Lobby. Walking distance to Haeundae Beach (250m) and Haeundae Traditional Market (350m).

transportRoutes.segment: ICN Airport → Seoul Station (AREX Express Train)
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: AREX Express Train (직통열차) + Subway Line 4 or Taxi to Hotel
transportRoutes.duration: 43 min (T1) / 51 min (T2) to Seoul Stn + 10 min to Myeongdong
transportRoutes.costPerAdult: 13,000 KRW (~$9.50 USD) Express / 4,450–5,050 KRW (~$3.50 USD) All-Stop
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Board AREX Express at ICN B1 Transit Center → Arrive Seoul Station B7 → Transfer to Subway Line 4 (2 stops to Myeong-dong Stn) or take a 7-min taxi (~6,000 KRW) to Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.

transportRoutes.segment: ICN Airport → Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (Airport Limousine Bus)
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Purchase ticket at ICN Terminal 1 (Stops 5B-1, 5B-2) or Terminal 2 (B1 Bus Terminal) → Ride Bus #6015 → Alight at 'Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong' stop → Walk 2 minutes (120m) to Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.

transportRoutes.segment: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong → N Seoul Tower
transportRoutes.itineraryClaim: Take bus to Namsun Tower (N Seoul Tower). 31 min. bus ride.
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Namsan Sunhwan Shuttle Bus 01A or 01B (남산순환버스) OR Free Cable Car Shuttle
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Option A (Direct Bus to Summit): Walk 5 min to Lotte Young Plaza / Myeongdong Stn Exit 3 bus stop → Board Namsan Shuttle Bus 01A or 01B → Alight at N Seoul Tower stop. Option B (Cable Car): Walk 10 min from Myeongdong Stn Exit 3 (or ride free Cable Car shuttle 12:00–20:30 from Exit 1) to Namsan Cable Car base station (83 Sopa-ro).
transportRoutes.sourceTitle: N Seoul Tower Official Getting Here Guide

transportRoutes.itineraryClaim: Night Market Exploration - Gwangjang Market Or Mangwon Market
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Seoul Subway Line 2 + Line 1 (Gwangjang) OR Line 2 + Line 6 (Mangwon)
transportRoutes.stepByStep: To Gwangjang Market: Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn (Line 2) → Euljiro 4(sa)-ga Stn (walk 6 min north) or Jongno 5(o)-ga Stn (Line 1, Exit 7/8). To Mangwon Market: Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn (Line 2) → Hapjeong Stn → Transfer Line 6 to Mangwon Stn (Exit 2, walk 5 min).

transportRoutes.segment: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong → Gyeongbokgung Palace & Bukchon Hanok Village
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Seoul Subway Line 2 → Line 3 (Gyeongbokgung Stn / Anguk Stn) or Bus 109/171/7016
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Take Line 2 at Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn → Transfer at Euljiro 3(sam)-ga Stn to Line 3 (Northbound) → Alight at Gyeongbokgung Stn (Exit 5) for Palace, or Anguk Stn (Exit 3) for Cafe Onion Anguk & Bukchon Hanok Village.

transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Seoul Subway Line 2 (Direct Green Circle Line — No Transfers Required)
transportRoutes.duration: Hotel → DDP: 8 min (3 stops) / Hotel → Seongsu Stn: 21 min (8 stops)
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Board Subway Line 2 at Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn (2 min from hotel) → 3 stops east to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Stn (Exit 1 for DDP) → Continue 5 stops east on Line 2 to Seongsu Stn (Exits 2, 3, and 4).

transportRoutes.segment: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong → Starfield COEX Mall (Gangnam)
transportRoutes.itineraryClaim: Take subway to Starfield COEX Mall (47 min)
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Seoul Subway Line 2 Direct (Euljiro 1-ga Stn → Samseong Stn)
transportRoutes.duration: 32 min in-train (15 stops on Line 2; ~42–45 min door-to-door)
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Board Subway Line 2 at Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn (inner circle toward Wangsimni/Jamsil) → Ride 15 stops direct to Samseong (World Trade Center Seoul) Stn → Use underground passage at Exit 5 & 6 directly into Millennium Plaza & Starfield COEX Mall.

transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Seoul Subway Line 2 → Line 3 (Jongno 3-ga Stn) or 15-min Walk
transportRoutes.duration: 10 min by subway (or 15-min walk via Cheonggyecheon)
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Board Line 2 at Euljiro 1(il)-ga Stn (1 stop to Euljiro 3-ga) → Transfer to Line 3 (1 stop to Jongno 3-ga Stn) → Exit 4 for Ikseon-dong Hanok Village (Jayeondo Salt Bread & Ikseon Chwihyang), Exit 5/6 for Insadong Culture Street.

transportRoutes.verifiedMode: City Bus #421 or #143 OR Subway Line 2 → Line 6 (Itaewon Stn)
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Option A (Subway): Line 2 Euljiro 1-ga Stn → Sindang Stn → Transfer to Line 6 → Itaewon Stn (Exits 1–4). Option B (Direct Bus): Walk to Lotte Dept Store bus stop → Take Blue Bus #421 direct to Hamilton Hotel (Itaewon Stn).
transportRoutes.sourceTitle: VISITKOREA Official — Itaewon Special Tourist Zone

transportRoutes.segment: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong → Seoul Station → Busan Station (KTX)
transportRoutes.itineraryClaim: Take uber/taxi to Seoul Station. Board KTX train 45 miuntes early to secure luggage space. Takes 2 hours and 45 minutes to get to Busan.
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Taxi/Uber to Seoul Station + KORAIL KTX Gyeongbu Line High-Speed Train
transportRoutes.duration: Taxi: 8–10 min / KTX: 2 hr 15 min – 3 hr 00 min (depending on stops)
transportRoutes.costPerAdult: 59,800 KRW (~$44.00 USD) KTX Standard Class + ~6,000 KRW Taxi
transportRoutes.stepByStep: Leave hotel by 10:00 AM → 8-min Uber/Kakao T taxi to Seoul Station (or Line 4 Myeong-dong Stn, 2 stops to Seoul Stn) → Check departure board 20 min before departure (platforms open ~15–20 min prior, not 45 min early) → Store large suitcases in end-of-car luggage racks → Arrive Busan Station.

transportRoutes.segment: Busan Station → L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE
transportRoutes.itineraryClaim: Take uber/taxi to L7 Haeundae Lotte Hotel
transportRoutes.verifiedMode: Uber/Taxi OR Express Bus #1003 OR Busan Subway Line 1 → Line 2
transportRoutes.duration: Taxi: 35–45 min / Subway: 45 min (Busan Stn Line 1 → Seomyeon → Line 2 Haeundae Stn Exit 5)
transportRoutes.costPerAdult: Taxi: ~18,000–22,000 KRW total (~$14–$16 USD) / Subway: 1,650 KRW (~$1.20 USD) per person
transportRoutes.costTwoAdults: Taxi: ~20,000 KRW total / Subway: 3,300 KRW total
transportRoutes.stepByStep: With luggage, take a taxi/Uber from Busan Station Taxi Stand (~35–45 min, ~20,000 KRW) directly to L7 HAEUNDAE (55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil). For public transit: Take Busan Metro Line 1 at Busan Stn → Transfer at Seomyeon Stn to Line 2 → Alight at Haeundae Stn Exit 5 (walk 5 min).
transportRoutes.sourceTitle: Visit Busan Official — Haeundae Access Guide
